REPORT
Date MAY 8, 1933.
Subject (in full) Communist meeting held in Western Chapel, Chinese controlled territory.
Made by D. I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by （签名）
Agents A-4337 and 4252 report that between 6 p.m. and 7 p.m. May 7, some eight communist adherents in the Western District of Shanghai held a meeting in an unnumbered house behind the Central Mint, Chung Shan Road, Western Chapel. The gathering which was presided over by one Lau Yuan (老袁) passed the following resolutions:-
(1) That efforts be made to strengthen communist activities in the Western District.
(2) That the work of each member of the executive staff of cells in factories be carefully examined and that only efficient comrades be appointed to the Executive Staff.
（批：报）
(3) That groups be organized to hunt down reactionaries.
(4) That cells in factories hold regular meetings.
(5) That each comrade be urged to enlist new recruits.
Lau Yuan's description is as follows:-
Age about 40, height about 5' 4", round face, sallow complexion, usually wears grey cloth longgown and grey hat. Native of Pootung.
（批：Recorded / SBR / 8/5）
Kuh Pao-hwa

报告
日期：1933年5月8日。
主题（全称）：在华界西区礼拜堂举行的共产党会议。
呈报人：督察顾宝华 转呈人 （签名）
探员 A-4337 和 4252 报告称，5月7日下午6时至7时之间，约八名共产党追随者在上海西区中山路中央造币厂后方、西区礼拜堂附近的一栋无门牌号的房屋内举行了一次会议。此次集会由一名叫老袁（Lau Yuan）的人主持，通过了以下决议：-
(1) 努力加强西区的共产党活动。
(2) 仔细审查各工厂细胞执行委员会成员的工作，仅任命能干的同志进入执行委员会。
（批：报）
(3) 组织小组搜捕反动分子。
(4) 工厂内的细胞定期举行会议。
(5) 敦促每位同志招募新成员。
老袁的体貌特征如下：-
年龄约40岁，身高约5英尺4英寸，圆脸，面色蜡黄，通常身穿灰色布长衫，头戴灰色帽子。浦东人。
（批：已记录 / 特别巡捕房登记处 / 5月8日）
